$comment: The main merge-queue ruleset (docs/orchestration.md, 'The merge queue'). Owner-applied — sessions cannot mutate repo settings: gh api repos/FloorLamp/allos/rulesets --method POST --input .github/merge-queue-ruleset.json  (or Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New branch ruleset, mirroring these values). The required checks are the three cheap tiers + gitleaks, matching what ci.yml runs on merge_group; requiring a check that never reports on merge_group stalls the queue forever. bypass_actors keeps repository admins able to push to main directly (the owner does, mid-session) — those pushes stay covered by ci-main.yml.
name: main merge queue
